questions.content: Câu 1: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to each question Consumers have created a new revenue stream for music companies. They upload their favourite music video clips or remixed versions to platforms such as YouTube.
options: A. Consumers have created a new revenue stream for music companies, hence uploading their favourite music video clips or remixed versions to platforms such as YouTube.
B. Consumers have created a new revenue stream for music companies by uploading their favourite music video clips or remixed versions to platforms such as YouTube.
C. Consumers have created a new revenue stream for music companies after uploading their favourite music video clips or remixed versions to platforms such as YouTube.
D. Consumers have created a new revenue stream for music companies, so they upload their favourite music video clips or remixed versions to platforms such as YouTube.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: B By + Ving = bằng cách làm gì Dịch: Người tiêu dùng đã tạo ra một nguồn doanh thu mới cho các công ty âm nhạc. Họ tải các video clip âm nhạc yêu thích hoặc các phiên bản phối lại lên các nền tảng như YouTube.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the letter A, B, C or D to complete the sentences with given words The winner/ be/ chosen/ a celebrity panel/ and/ home viewers.
options: A. The winner be chosen by a celebrity panel and home viewers.
B. The winner are chosen a celebrity panel and home viewers.
C. The winner will be chosen by a celebrity panel and home viewers.
D. The winner will be chosen a celebrity panel and home viewers.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: C Câu bị động thời tương lai đơn Dịch: Người thắng cuộc sẽ được lựa chọn bởi 1 nhóm ban giám khảo và người xem truyền hình.

questions.content: Câu 3: They/ talk/ about/ young/ pop star/ now.
options: A. They are talking about a young pop star now.
B. They talk about a young pop star now.
C. They have been talking about a young pop star now.
D. They will talk about a young pop star now.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: A Câu chia hiện tại tiếp diễn vì có mốc thời gian “now” Dịch: lúc này họ đang bàn tán về 1 ngôi sao nhạc pop.

questions.content: Câu 4: At that time, his parents/ never/ allow/ him/ play the drum.
options: A. At that time, his parents never allowed him play the drum.
B. At that time, his parents never allowed him to play the drum.
C. At that time, his parents never allowed him to playing the drum.
D. At that time, his parents never allowed him playing the drum.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: B allow sb to V: cho phép ai làm gì play + the + nhạc cụ: chơi nhạc cụ gì Dịch: Hồi đó, bố mẹ anh ấy không bao giờ cho anh ấy chơi nhạc cụ.

questions.content: Câu 5: Rewrite sentences without changing the meaning How about booking tickets for the concert in advance?
options: A. Let’s booking tickets for the concert in advance.
B. Why not booking tickets for the concert in advance?
C. What about booking tickets for the concert in advance?
D. Shall we booking tickets for the concert in advance?
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: C How about = What about + Ving: dùng để gợi ý Dịch: Tại sao chúng ta không đặt vé cho buổi hoà nhạc trước?

questions.content: Câu 6: Van Cao is the musician who wrote “Tien Quan Ca”.
options: A. Van Cao didn’t compose “Tien Quan Ca”.
B. “Tien Quan Ca” is Van Cao’s favourite song.
C. “Tien Quan Ca” was written by Van Cao.
D. Van Cao is listening to “Tien Quan Ca”.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: C Câu bị động thì quá khứ đơn Dịch: Bài hát Tiến quân ca được viết bởi nhạc sĩ Văn Cao.

questions.content: Câu 7: Beethoven’s music is so dedicating that many people love it.
options: A. Many people enjoy Beethoven’s dedicating music.
B. Beethoven’s music is too dedicating for many people to love.
C. No one like Beethoven’s music.
D. Beethoven’s music is not dedicating enough for many people.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: A Cấu trúc: be + so + adj + that + S + V: quá…đến nỗi mà… Dịch: Âm nhạc của Beethoven thì quá uyển chuyển đến nỗi mà rất nhiều người yêu thích nó.

questions.content: Câu 8: There has never been a more successful entertainment programme than Pop Idol.
options: A. Pop Idol is the most successful entertainment programme ever.
B. Pop Idol can be a more successful entertainment programme.
C. Pop Idol is one of the most successful entertainment programmes.
D. Pop Idol had never been more successful than it is now.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng là: A Dịch: Chưa bao giờ có một chương trình giải trí nào thành công hơn Pop Idol.
